faq.a1a: Sending a package is designed to be quick and stress-free. From the app, you start by choosing Send Package, select the box size that best fits your item, pick your preferred lockers, and add the recipient's details. Once payment is completed, you'll instantly receive a secure drop-off code. Simply place your package in the locker using that code and you're done. To avoid extra charges, we recommend using the size guide before confirming. If you prefer a visual walkthrough, you can watch a
faq.a2: Storage gives you a flexible way to keep items safe for short periods. You choose how long you want to store your item (between 1 and 30 days), complete payment, and receive a secure drop-off code. After placing your item in the locker, a retrieval code is generated for collection at your convenience. Storage fees depend on locker size and are charged per day. To avoid late fees, make sure to collect your item before the selected storage period expires.
faq.a3: Locker sizes are designed to match different item types and keep pricing fair. Small lockers are ideal for compact items like shoes, books, or small packages. Medium lockers comfortably fit laptops, clothing, and small appliances, while large lockers are best for bulkier or multiple items. Each size has a fixed delivery fee and a daily storage rate. If you're unsure which size to choose, the size guide can help you decide and prevent unexpected extra charges.
faq.a4: Pricing is transparent and straightforward. Delivery is charged once based on the locker size you select, while storage is charged daily if you choose to store items. Your payment includes insurance coverage and real-time tracking, with no hidden fees. Additional charges only apply if the selected locker size is upgraded or the storage period is extended.
